note: v1, written - the first round. EVERYTHING FALLS TO ONE: the Collatz rule as melody and form. Each phrase starts from a seed and a physical clarinet plays its path (n -> n/2 or 3n+1), one number an eighth at scale degree round(log2 n) on G major, so every climb is a melodic climb and every phrase - of its own irregular length - ends 4 2 1 = B3 A3 G3, the hook. Seeds 6 / 7 12 3 7 / 9 18 11 / 27 31 27 41 (27's 111-step climb to 9232 is the drop) / the loop 1 4 2 1. Tracker arps on a 5-bit chip, hats on the prime steps of every 32 (the sieve), an analog bass and a sine sub on I vi IV V, a dream-vox pad; a humanized voice on a radio reads 7's path aloud, and on the break 'four, two, one' turns from speech to song on the hook's own notes. 128 bpm, 164 bars, 310 s. compscore seeds 0/11: 93.46/91.55 (draft 87.6/87.7: spectrum 46 -> 83 from the body - the analog bass, the pad and arps an octave down, a 1.5 kHz dip; cohesion 31 -> 95; the outro keeps the band to its last beat to bleed into t3 - a fade read as a 42 dB drop).
